section: Iterate — change: atomic-frs cut 1, delivery criteria into FR-01.22
title: Cut AC21-AC25 out of FR-01.11 into FR-01.22
context: FR-01.11 holds unrelated behaviours; AC21-AC25 form one purpose, delivering a finished change when the host cannot merge it.
decision: fr_split moved the five criteria verbatim into the new FR-01.22 with an AC-Move-Map and retagged the bound tests. Schnitt 2 (AC30-34, AC37) is not cut.
consequences: Old ids FR-01.11/AC21-25 resolve through the move map. Three integration tests pinned the catalog size and were raised to 22 FRs, comparing section order sorted.
rationale: One purpose per requirement keeps coverage and history readable; the tool's conservation check and the move-map gates guard the move.
rejected: Hand-editing spec and tags; cutting several groups in one PR, which the operator wanted to approve one cut at a time.
